modules.title: Introduction to Ahịrịokwu (Sentences)
modules.html:
Igbo sentence structure and types. This section covers introduction to ahịrịokwu (sentences).

Key points

  • Ahịrịokwu 'Nwa ahụ bụ ozu' nwere ụdị nnyemaka wo — Mmekpọ.
  • N'ahịrịokwu bụ 'Ada na-eri nri', gịnị bụ 'na-' — Ngwaa nnyemaka.
  • Ahịrịokwu a 'Bịa ebe a!' bụ ụdị wo — Ahịrịokwu iwu.
  • Ahịrịokwu 'O riri nri?' bụ ụdị wo — Ahịrịokwu ajụjụ.
  • Gịnị bụ 'Ahịrịokwu' — Sentence.

Worked examples

Q: Ahịrịokwu 'Nwa ahụ bụ ozu' nwere ụdị nnyemaka wo?
A: Mmekpọ — 'Bụ' is a stative or copular verb (ngwaa mmekpọ) that links the subject to a complement.

Q: N'ahịrịokwu bụ 'Ada na-eri nri', gịnị bụ 'na-'?
A: Ngwaa nnyemaka — 'Na' acts as an auxiliary verb (ngwaa nnyemaka) indicating continuous tense.

examples.q: Ahịrịokwu 'Nwa ahụ bụ ozu' nwere ụdị nnyemaka wo?
N'ahịrịokwu bụ 'Ada na-eri nri', gịnị bụ 'na-'?

quiz.q: Ahịrịokwu 'Nwa ahụ bụ ozu' nwere ụdị nnyemaka wo?
quiz.solution: 'Bụ' is a stative or copular verb (ngwaa mmekpọ) that links the subject to a complement.

quiz.q: N'ahịrịokwu bụ 'Ada na-eri nri', gịnị bụ 'na-'?
quiz.solution: 'Na' acts as an auxiliary verb (ngwaa nnyemaka) indicating continuous tense.

quiz.q: Ahịrịokwu a 'Bịa ebe a!' bụ ụdị wo?
quiz.solution: This is an imperative sentence (ahịrịokwu iwu), which issues a command.

quiz.q: Ahịrịokwu 'O riri nri?' bụ ụdị wo?
quiz.solution: An interrogative sentence (ahịrịokwu ajụjụ) ends with a question mark and asks for information.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Ahịrịokwu'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Sentence.

quiz.q: Olee ụdị ahịrịokwu bụ nke a: 'Onye ka i bụ?'
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Ajụjụ.

quiz.q: Kedu akara edemede a na-eji egosi nkwụsị obere n'ahịrịokwu?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Kọma.

quiz.q: N'ahịrịokwu a: 'Ada na-eri nri', kedu mkpụrụ okwu bụ ngwaa?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: na-eri.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Ahịrịokwu mfe'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Simple sentence.

quiz.q: Asụsụ Igbo nwere ụbọchị ahịa ole?
quiz.solution: The Igbo calendar revolves around four market days: Eke, Orie, Afo, and Nkwo.

quiz.q: Kedu onye n'obodo na-ahụ maka ikpe ikpe na idozi okwu?
options: Ndị Nze na Ọzo na ndị okenye
quiz.solution: Titled men and elders (Oha na Eze/Ndi Ichie) handle conflict resolution.

quiz.q: Kedu ụbọchị ahịa anọ dị n'Igbo?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Eke, Orie, Afọ, Nkwọ.

quiz.q: Kedu ihe 'Ahịa' pụtara?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Market.

quiz.q: Olee ụbọchị ahịa dị n'ala Igbo?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Eke, Orie, Afọ, Nkwọ.

quiz.q: Mkpuru okwu bụ 'Aha' na-akọwa kedu ihe?
options: Onye, ebe ma ọ bụ ihe
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Onye, ebe ma ọ bụ ihe.

quiz.q: Ahịa ole dị n'otu izu ụka Igbo?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Anọ.

quiz.q: Kedu ahịa kacha ebube n'ala Igbo?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Eke.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Friend'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Enyi.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Head'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Isi.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Eze'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: King.

quiz.q: Kedu nke bụ 'Ọnwa'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Moon.

quiz.q: Kedu nke bụ 'Anụ'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Meat/Animal.

quiz.q: Me ake nufi da 'Aure'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Marriage.

quiz.q: Menene 'Zamantowa'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Assimilation.

quiz.q: Menene 'Sana'a'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Occupation/Trade.

quiz.q: Wanne ne 'Alkalami'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Pen.

quiz.q: Olee n'ime ndị a bụ njikọ (conjunction)?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Na.

quiz.q: Kedu ka a na-asụ 'Sit down' n'Igbo?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Nọdụ ala.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Bicycle' n'Igbo?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Ịnyịnya ígwè.

quiz.q: Gịnị ka a na-eji anabata ọbịa n'ala Igbo?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Ọjị.

quiz.q: Kedu ihe bụ 'Nfepụ' (Elision)?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Mwepụ ụdaume.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Door'?
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Uzo.
